decisions.reason: Conditioning production of the separate print version does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The print-production condition does not alter the digital flipbook's two-page spread behavior or even-page requirement.
The decision about whether to produce a print version does not change the digital flipbook platform or free-to-start requirement.
The table of contents must still use finalized pagination regardless of whether a print version is requested.
Making print production conditional does not remove or modify the image-quality enhancement requirement for the publication.
Accurate cover page references remain required for the digital publication and are unaffected by conditional print production.
The magazine still requires cohesive layout assembly for the digital flipbook; only the separate print output became conditional.
The template remains necessary for the magazine layout independently of whether a print version is produced.
The inaugural-issue date and edition label are unchanged by the conditional print-output decision.
The tribute page remains required in the magazine's end matter regardless of print production.
Advertisements must still render clearly in the digital publication; the source does not relax or alter that quality requirement.
The approved readable Inter treatment remains applicable to the digital magazine and is unaffected by conditional print production.
